# Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Solomon the Shopkeeper — User Manual

---

## 1. Overview
**Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Solomon the Shopkeeper** is an enhancement software designed to add new features to the titles in the *Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos* series. The main interface (below) provides quick access to all key features.

![Main Menu](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
---

## 2. Installation
1. Download the application archive.
2. Extract the contents into a directory/folder with **write permissions**.

---

## 3. First Launch & Initial Setup
* Upon starting the application for the first time, it will automatically search for installed games from the series.
* **Troubleshooting:** If the application fails to detect installed games, verify that the game installation paths are properly configured in the Windows System Registry.
* After detecting the games, the software will unpack and extract required data files. **Note:** This initial process may take a few minutes to complete.

---

## 4. Main Menu & Token System
In the main menu (see Figure 1), you can perform various actions, primarily opening booster packs by spending **tokens**.

* **Token Generation:** You gain 1 token every **24 hours**.
* **Maximum Capacity:** You can hold a maximum of **2 tokens** at any given time.
* **Timer Reset:** As soon as a token is consumed, a new 24-hour countdown timer begins.
* **Checking Status:** You can check the remaining time until your next token generation in the **Options** menu.

---

## 5. Opening Booster Packs
When opening a booster pack, you must select which game version's card set to draw from:

![Booster select](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

* **Game Availability:** Sets belonging to games that are **not installed** cannot be selected.
* **Card Rarities:** In line with the mechanics of the original game series, card rarities are not factored into pack openings.
* **Duplicates:** Booster packs (containing 3 cards) can yield both new cards and duplicates.
* **Set Completion:** In the rare event that you possess the maximum allowed copies (255) of every card in a particular set, that set's booster pack will become unavailable for selection.

---

## 6. Card Trading System
You can access the trading screen (below) via the main menu to trade excess duplicate cards for other previously owned cards at a **1:1 ratio**.

![Trading cards](data:image/png;base64,)

* **Definition of Duplicates:** Only copies beyond the standard deck-building limit count as tradable duplicates (i.e., from the **4th copy onwards**, since standard decks allow up to 3 copies per card, barring forbidden/limited list restrictions).
* **Restrictions:** You cannot trade for a card unless you already own at least one copy of it (i.e., the card is 'known' to your collection).
* **Visual Indicators:**
  * **White Background:** Tradable duplicate cards.
  * **Blue Background:** Non-tradable cards.
* **How to Trade:** Simply **drag and drop** the tradable cards to complete a trade.

---

## 7. Heart of the Cards Booster Pack
The **"Heart of the Cards"** booster feature offers a guaranteed way to expand your collection:

![Heart of the Cards](data:image/png;base64,)

* **Cost:** 3 duplicate cards (4th copy onwards).
* **Reward:** A single-card booster pack from one of the three game sets that is **guaranteed to be a new card**.
* **Availability:** If all cards within a set are already owned (known), that set's Heart of the Cards booster will not be available.

---

## 8. Options & Settings
Access the Options screen (below) to configure application settings.

![Options](data:image/png;base64,)

* **Token Info:** View the exact time until your next token is generated.
* **Games Recognized:** Confirm which of the three games the software has successfully linked to (Yugi, Kaiba, Joey).
* **Language Settings:** Within the Options menu, you can change the language of the **cards**.
  * *Note 1:* This change **requires a restart** of the *Shopkeeper* application.
  * *Note 2:* Changing this setting affects only the card text/images, not the user interface language of the application itself.
